question: Which newly designated Ramsar Site is recognized for hosting the largest population of Sarus Cranes in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarsai Nawar Wetland, Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Sarsai Nawar Wetland**, located in Uttar Pradesh, is one of the wetlands recognized under the Ramsar Convention as a Ramsar Site.
 
• This wetland is renowned for hosting the **largest population of Sarus Cranes** in India, which are also the world's tallest flying birds.
